item.title: Capital Projects
item.description:
Public works capital improvement projects.

Current project data#

  • Municipal Development featured projects

    The City’s maintained index highlights major transportation, facility, safety, parks, and public-space capital projects, providing an accessible project gateway while the machine-readable project-data endpoint is unavailable.

  • Municipal Development project data

    This maintained City dataset is the starting point for current Municipal Development projects. It is intentionally linked live because capital-project schedules, scopes, and statuses are subject to change.

item.title: City Facilities
item.description:
City buildings and facilities.

Public-facility references#

  • Accessible City park and recreation facilities

    The City identifies accessible parks, recreation facilities, and programs, with an accompanying location map. It is a maintained public-facing resource rather than a static facilities inventory.

item.title: Parks & Recreation
item.description:
Parks and recreation facilities and programs.

Plans and Data#

  • ABC Comprehensive Plan, Chapter 10: Parks & Open Space (2025 Update)

    The parks and open space element of the adopted Albuquerque/Bernalillo County Comprehensive Plan provides policy direction for park access, recreation, trail connections, conservation, stewardship, and an integrated open-space network.

  • Bernalillo County Open Space Holdings

    This live Bernalillo County GIS service maps county real-estate holdings, including open space, parks and recreation facilities, public-safety facilities, and other county properties. It is maintained as data rather than a static downloadable document.
